links.comparator_used: Native ChatGPT-4 model (not fine-tuned) compared with a fine-tuned model ('The Knee Guide') built with instruction-based fine-tuning and RLHF for readability and source citation
links.outcome: Readability (FKGL, FRES) and quality (DISCERN) of patient education answers on high tibial osteotomy and knee OA
links.effect: FKGL 8.2 (range 5-10.7, ±1.42) vs 13.9 (range 11-16, ±1.39); FRES 60 (range 47-76, ±7.83) vs 32 (range 14-47, ±8.3); mean DISCERN 45.9 (range 33-66) vs 38.41 (range 25-46); all differences p < 0.001
links.quote: Fine-tuning ChatGPT significantly improved the readability and quality of HTO-related information.

design_hint: reading-level and source-citation customization of ChatGPT
